newsitem.title: USA: Wabash in pact with Fruehauf on asset bid.
newsitem.headline: Wabash in pact with Fruehauf on asset bid.

text.p: Wabash National Corp said Wednesday it reached an expense reimbursement agreement with Fruehauf Trailer Corp in connection with Wabash's proposal to purchase some Fruehauf assets.
Wabash proposes to buy substantially all of the remaining Fruehauf assets other than manufacturing plants in Mexico and Ft. Madison, Iowa.
The company said it proposes to purchase the assets pursuant to the asset sale bid procedures established by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware in pending Chapter 11 proceedings.
This is the first time Wabash had announced it would purchase some of the Fruehauf assets, a company spokeswoman said.
The assets could include Fruehauf's sales and distribution network, intellectual property, and a manufacturing facility, she added.

Wabash said the expense reimbursement agreement provides for the payment of a $1.5 million "break-up" fee plus certain expenses if the bankruptcy court accepts and approves an offer to purchase the Fruehauf assets other than the offer it submits.
Terms of the expense reimbursement agreement are subject to approval by the bankruptcy court, Wabash said.
The proposed purchase is subject to approval by the board of directors of Wabash National, the U.S. bankruptcy court and certain regulatory agencies.
Wabash makes and markets standard and customized truck trailers.
